verses.pali: … Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye labhanti tathāgatappaveditaṁ dhammavinayaṁ savanāya;
verses.english: … so too the sentient beings who get to hear the teaching and training proclaimed by a Realized One are few,

verses.pali: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye na labhanti tathāgatappaveditaṁ dhammavinayaṁ savanāya.
verses.english: while those sentient beings who don’t get to hear the teaching and training proclaimed by a Realized One are many.
